ja: Netflix映画『ULTRAMAN： RISING』より特徴的なシルエットのULTRAMANが、全てのプラモデル未経験者に贈る入門用シリーズ「ENTRY GRADE」に登場！
• 劇中さながらのプロポーションを再現。
• 全高約15cm。固定モデルだから構えポーズがしっかり決まる。
• タッチゲートだからパーツは手で“プチッ！”ととれる。
• 少ないパーツ数でプラモデルが初めてでも道具不要でサクサク組み立て可能。
• 体の模様が緻密に再現されたEMIのフィギュアが付属。
• 最小限の可動で、劇中で印象的なEMIを抱き上げるシーンが再現可能。ポーズを安定させる専用台座も付属。
en: ULTRAMAN with a distinctive silhouette from the Netflix movie "ULTRAMAN: RISING " appears in the introductory series " ENTRY GRADE" for all those who have no experience with plastic models!
• Reproduce the proportions just like in the movie.
• Total height approximately 15cm. Since it is a fixed model, the stance pose is well determined.
• Because it is a touch gate, parts can be removed by hand.
• With a small number of parts, even if it is your first time building a plastic model, you can easily assemble it without any tools.
• Comes with an EMI figure whose body pattern is precisely reproduced.
• With minimal movement, you can recreate the memorable scene in the movie where EMI is picked up. A special pedestal is also included to stabilize the pose.
